text:
kevin: Quick heads-up — kicking off the syd1 readiness gate for the new GPU cluster (syd1-a100x8). Want a quick run through of the smoke + SLO gates before we hand this to SRE for 24/7.
maria: On it. I'll validate the BGP peers and internal CIDR routes. Will post results in a few.
jordan: I started the scheduling smoke: deploying the test job to force allocation to GPU nodes.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: started run 'syd1/gpu-smoke/2026-03-18-01'
kevin: checklist we're aiming for:
- control plane reachable from control-plane-subnet
- kubelet ready on all gpu nodes
- nvml visible + nvidia-device-plugin healthy
- prefix/KV cache warmup ok for typical 2k token workload
- cross-region fallback (syd1 -> syd-backup) validated
- cost sanity: hourly burn within projected buffer
maria: BGP look: up. routes learned: 10.40.0.0/16 -> edge-router-2, standby path ok. no asymmetric nexthop.
jordan: kubectl commands:
```
kubectl get nodes -l instance-type=gpu -o wide
kubectl describe daemonset nvidia-device-plugin -n kube-system
kubectl get pods -n infra smoke-runner -o wide
```
infra-bot: smoke-runner: pod scheduled on node syd1-gpu-04
infra-bot: nvml-check: PASS (3 GPUs visible)
amy: Cost note — initial sizing uses 8 x a100-80g on ondemand. If we keep this as baseline expected bill ~ $22/hr. We have a 20% buffer in projected MLP. If we need reserved, we should start procurement now.
jordan: logs show a transient kubelet OOM on syd1-gpu-01 ~ 02:15UTC, restarted kubelet, node returned Ready in ~45s. Filing short issue: #infra-706
kevin: Is that within SLO? We tolerate node recovers <5m. This was 45s so OK, but add to post-handoff notes.
maria: Network perf check: iperf3 syd1-gpu-04 -> redis-cache returns 9.6 Gbps, within expected. MTU OK, no fragmentation.
infra-bot: kv-cache warmup: latency p95=18ms for 2k tokens emulation -> within target (<25ms)
sre-ops: Can we validate fallback? I will trigger a simulated region outage and confirm routing.
sre-ops: Initiating outbound route withdrawal for edge-router-1 (simulated)
infra-bot: routing-sim: syd1 now routing via standby path, avg additional latency +32ms. fallbacks for small payloads pass, large streaming has graceful degrade configured.
amy: Quick ops-cost calc: if we enable autoscale-burst to 12 nodes for peak, monthly delta ~ +$6k. We should decide tier before handoff.
kevin: Outstanding items: 1) add kubelet oom root cause note to #infra-706, 2) decide reserved vs on-demand + autoscale policy, 3) schedule post-handoff 48h watch with SRE, 4) add runbook snippet for fallback manual failover.
jordan: I've pushed a small change to the smoke job to extend load-run to 15m for soak. Will monitor and report back.
maria: IAM sanity: service accounts for model-exec have only required permissions. No wildcard policies found. Audit log shows no denied actions during tests.
sre-ops: We ran canary traffic through the new routing policy, latency increase within SLO for 99th (<250ms). Error-rate unchanged.
kevin: Unless anyone has blocking items, I'll move to formal handoff at 02:55UTC. @sre-ops expect a handoff doc in #oncall-handoff shortly.
amy: +1 from cost side if we keep monitoring and revisit reserved credits after 2 weeks.
sre-ops: +1. Prepare the 48h watch schedule and escalation matrix.
infra-bot: readiness-check: ALL_GATES_PASS
kevin: Awesome — thanks everyone. Handoff scheduled, I'll post the runbook and postmortem template after the 48h watch completes. :white_check_mark:
